name: noneedwork
description: Local-first software engineering agent built on PI with durable execution, sandboxing, evals, permissions, and bounded multi-agent coordination.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @noneedwork/runtime && npm run build -w @noneedwork/cli && npm run build -w @noneedwork/desktop
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @noneedwork/protocol && npm run build -w @noneedwork/pi-adapter && npm run build -w @noneedwork/client-sdk
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
